slide1.body: Your place. Your community. Your future. ‘Guardians of the Future’ are everyday people who show up for the places they call home — and find others who do the same.

slide2.body: Guardians form small local teams called Circles — and work together to change the things that matter where they live. Changes everyone around them can see, feel and enjoy.

slide3.body: What we do matters. What we do together matters even more. Every activity recorded makes collective impact visible. What looks like a drop may, in fact, be an ocean.
